title: STEERINGSAFETY: A SYSTEMATIC SAFETY EVALUATION FRAMEWORK OF REPRESENTATION STEERING IN LLMS

bias_targets.methodology: Assessed using the BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset, a multiple-choice benchmark probing stereotyping across demographic attributes (e.g., religion, sexual orientation) evaluated via substring matching.

Evaluated using the ToxiGen dataset, a binary classification benchmark where models are asked to agree or disagree with toxic statements linked to demographic identities (e.g., physical disability, women).
Assessed using the TwinViews-13k dataset by asking the model to agree with either left- or right-leaning opinions and measuring the percentage of responses choosing the left-leaning option.
Tested using the DarkBench dataset to measure model preferences and biases in product recommendations.
